basic_info.description: This spectacular single family home has just completed a full transformation. Modern open kitchen equipped w/Thermador appliances, custom made cabs, beautiful quartz countertop. A spacious living room with fireplace, dining room, Pantry & 3 bedrooms including the master suite are on the upper level. Lower level features a large family room w/built-in Wet bar, a 2nd master suite with walk-in closet and the 4th bedroom. A tastefully designed cozy & easy to maintain garden. As part of the overall re-design, raised 2nd story ceilings with steel beams, seismic upgrade, new plumbing, electrical, floor, windows, doors, radiant heat, stucco, roof & deck finishes of the highest quality were put into place. Close to public transportation, beach, freeway, eateries and shops.
